description: Top up your key (API access is paid per call past the free allowance; 100 GRID of service per 1 USDC). Step 1, with usdc (a whole number 1 to 20): the quote (GET /v1/access/quote) — the unsigned USDC transfer on Base to send from your own wallet and the message that wallet signs. Step 2, with tx and signature: credit the key (POST /v1/access/topup); a transaction credits once, and sending it again answers already: true. Nothing is signed or sent by this tool. Needs your key.

signature.description: personal_sign of the quoted message by the wallet that sent the transfer

tx.description: the hash of your USDC transfer on Base

name: taifoon_access_topup
